mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, it is 34 degrees with clear skies by Harriet Park. Expect an overnight low of 30 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the holiday. Refuse and recycling pickup normally scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday, and the recycling center will also be closed.
Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run and tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Other upcoming events include yoga tomorrow and various trivia nights starting Tuesday.
On November 9, an officer stopped a vehicle for unsafe operation, leading to an O W I arrest for a third offence.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload. The store is currently open but will be closing in 55 minutes, so make sure to get your order in soon.
